data.content:
The longest run created before October 28 2026 was executed by the **market‑researcher** agent and lasted **112.33 seconds**.

```json
{
  "question": "Among runs created before October 28, 2026, which one took the longest from start to finish? Give its agent name and its duration in seconds.",
  "sql": "SELECT a.name AS agent_name, r.id AS run_id,\n       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.finished_at - r.started_at)) AS duration_seconds\nFROM runs r\nJOIN agents a ON r.agent_id = a.id\nWHERE r.created_at < '2026-10-28'::date\n  AND r.started_at IS NOT NULL AND r.finished_at IS NOT NULL\nORDER BY duration_seconds DESC\nLIMIT 1",
  "row_count": 1,
  "answer": "The longest run was by agent 'market-researcher' with a duration of 112.33 seconds."
}
```
